about: House recipes, batch 04 (helper sA): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Pork Carnitas Tacos with Pickled Onion
recipes.summary: Pork shoulder braised until tender, crisped under the grill and piled into warm corn tortillas.

items: 1kg pork shoulder, cut into big chunks

steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan). Put the pork, orange juice, lime juice, garlic, cumin, oregano, bay leaves and salt in a lidded ovenproof pot with 1/2 cup water.
Cover and cook for 2 hours 30 minutes, until the pork shreds easily with a fork.
Shred the pork on a lined tray, spoon over some pot juices and grill for 6 minutes, until the edges crisp and brown.
Warm the tortillas in a dry frying pan for 30 seconds each side, until soft and flecked. Fill with pork, pickled onion and coriander and serve with lime.
notes: Food safety: pork shoulder is safe once it reaches 70°C inside, and this braise is cooked far past that when it shreds easily. Keep leftovers chilled within 2 hours.
Gluten-free: check the tortilla label.

recipes.title: Chicken in Chocolate Chilli Mole
recipes.summary: Chicken simmered in a deep, glossy mole of dried chilli, almonds, sesame, raisins and dark chocolate.
steps: Soak the chillies in hot water for 15 minutes, until soft, then drain. Toast the almonds and sesame seeds in a dry pan for 3 minutes, until golden.
Fry the onion and garlic in 1 tablespoon of oil for 6 minutes, until browned. Blend with the chillies, nuts, seeds, raisins, tomatoes, cinnamon, cloves, cumin and 1 cup of stock until very smooth.
Brown the chicken in the remaining oil in a wide pot for 8 minutes, until golden, then lift out. Pour the blended paste into the pot and fry for 8 minutes, stirring, until it darkens and thickens.
Stir in the chocolate and the remaining stock until melted, add the chicken, cover and simmer for 35 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C in the thickest part and the sauce coats a spoon.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, drain and serve with the chicken and mole.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part and the juices must run clear.
Dried chilli heat varies: taste the paste before adding chocolate.

recipes.title: Black Bean Enchiladas with Tasty Cheese
recipes.summary: Corn tortillas rolled around spiced black beans and cheese, baked under a smoky red sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the beans and corn and cook for 4 minutes, mashing about a third of the beans, until thick. Take off the heat and stir through half the cheese.
Spread 1/2 cup of enchilada sauce over the base of a baking dish. Warm the tortillas, fill each with the bean mix, roll up and lay seam-side down.
Pour over the remaining sauce, scatter with the remaining cheese and bake for 20 minutes, until bubbling and golden. Top with sour cream and coriander.
notes: Vegetarian.
Gluten-free: check the tortilla and sauce labels.

recipes.title: Huevos Divorciados
recipes.summary: Two fried eggs on crisp corn tortillas, one under red sauce and one under green, split by black beans.
steps: Warm the black beans in a small pan for 4 minutes, until hot and slightly mashed. Warm the red sauce and the salsa in two separate pans.
Fry the tortillas in a little oil for 1 minute each side, until crisp at the edges, and set two on each plate.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil for 3 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks still soft.
Top one egg with red sauce and one with salsa, spoon the beans down the middle and finish with avocado, coriander and lime.
notes: Food safety: serve eggs with set whites; cook the yolks through for young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Chorizo and Potato Breakfast Hash
recipes.summary: Crisp potato and smoky chorizo with capsicum and eggs baked right in the pan.
steps: Boil the potato for 6 minutes, until just tender, then drain well.
Fry the chorizo in the oil in a large ovenproof frying pan for 4 minutes, until crisp and the oil runs red. Add the onion, capsicum and paprika and cook for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the potato and cook for 8 minutes, turning only now and then, until golden and crisp.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 4 minutes, until the whites are set. Top with coriander and avocado.
notes: Food safety: cook the whites until set and the chorizo until steaming hot; serve firm-yolked eggs to children or pregnant guests.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Camarones a la Diabla with Rice
recipes.summary: Prawns in a fiery chipotle and tomato sauce over fluffy rice.
steps: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic and chipotle for 1 minute. Add the tomatoes and oregano and simmer for 8 minutes, until thick.
Blend the sauce until smooth and return it to the pan with the butter. Add the prawns and cook for 4 minutes, until they turn pink and opaque.
Stir through the lime juice and coriander and serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: prawns are cooked when pink, curled and opaque all the way through; don't keep cooked prawns more than 2 days.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Mexican Beef and Rice Stuffed Capsicums
recipes.summary: Capsicums filled with spiced beef, rice and beans and baked with melted cheese.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic and mince and cook for 8 minutes, until browned.
Stir in the taco seasoning, tomatoes, rice and beans and simmer for 5 minutes, until thick.
Fill the capsicum halves, set them in a baking dish with 1/2 cup water and cover with foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then uncover, scatter with cheese and bake for 15 minutes, until the capsicums are tender and the cheese is golden.
notes: Food safety: the mince filling must reach 75°C right through; cool leftover rice quickly and refrigerate within 1 hour.
Gluten-free: check the taco seasoning label.

recipes.title: Migas with Corn Chips and Eggs
recipes.summary: Soft scrambled eggs folded through crisp corn chips, tomato and jalapeno.
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Melt the butter in a frying pan over medium heat, then cook the jalapeno, spring onion and tomato for 2 minutes, until softened.
Add the eggs and stir gently for 3 minutes, until just set but still glossy.
Fold in the corn chips and cheese and serve straight away with coriander and salsa.
notes: Food safety: scramble the eggs until set throughout, with no runny egg, if serving to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Mushroom Quesadillas with Smoky Beans
recipes.summary: Golden tortillas filled with garlicky mushrooms, black beans and melted cheese.
steps: Cook the onion in half the oil in a frying pan for 5 minutes, until soft. Add the mushrooms and cook for 8 minutes, until browned and dry.
Add the garlic and paprika for 1 minute, then stir through the beans and mash lightly.
Fill four tortillas with the mushroom mix and cheese and top with the remaining tortillas.
Fry each quesadilla in a little oil for 3 minutes per side, until golden and the cheese melts. Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream and salsa.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Cochinita Pibil-Style Slow Pork
recipes.summary: Pork shoulder marinated in orange, lime and annatto and roasted slowly until it falls apart.

items: 1.5kg pork shoulder, cut into large chunks

steps: Mix the annatto, orange juice, lime juice, garlic, oregano, cumin, cinnamon, cloves and salt into a paste, rub over the pork and marinate for at least 4 hours.
Heat the oven to 150°C (130°C fan). Tip the pork and marinade into a deep roasting dish, add 1/2 cup water and seal tightly with baking paper and foil.
Roast for 3 hours 30 minutes, until the pork is very tender and shreds easily.
Shred the pork in its juices. Warm the tortillas and serve with pickled cabbage, pickled onion and coriander.
notes: Food safety: pork shoulder is safe at 70°C inside; this long roast far exceeds that, so check it shreds easily. Marinate in the fridge, not on the bench.
Gluten-free: check the tortilla label.

recipes.title: Chilean Beef and Corn Pie
recipes.summary: A layered pie of spiced beef, olives and egg under a golden sweet corn crust.
steps: Hard-boil two of the eggs for 10 minutes, until set, then cool, peel and slice.
Cook one onion in the oil for 6 minutes, until soft. Add the mince, garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for 8 minutes, until browned and cooked through. Cool slightly and stir in the raisins.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Blend the corn, milk, basil, butter, sugar and remaining raw egg until a thick, coarse purée, then cook it in a pan for 8 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Spoon the beef into a baking dish, top with the egg slices and olives, then spread over the corn mixture.
Bake for 30 minutes, until golden and bubbling at the edges, and rest for 10 minutes before serving.
notes: Food safety: the beef mince must reach 75°C right through before it goes in the pie; the pie should be steaming hot in the middle.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Beef Picadillo with Olives, Raisins and Rice
recipes.summary: Savoury beef mince with olives, raisins and tomato, served over white rice.
steps: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, then drain.
Cook the onion and capsicum in the oil for 6 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic, cumin and oregano for 1 minute.
Add the mince and cook for 8 minutes, until browned and cooked through. Stir in the tomatoes, olives, raisins and vinegar.
Simmer for 12 minutes, until thick, and serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: the mince must reach 75°C right through; refrigerate leftovers and rice within 1 hour.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Pernil-Style Roast Pork Shoulder
recipes.summary: A garlic and citrus-marinated pork shoulder roasted low and slow with a crackling top.

items: 2kg pork shoulder, skin on and scored

steps: Mix the garlic, orange juice, lime juice, oregano, cumin, salt and oil. Cut deep slits in the pork, work the marinade in and rest it in the fridge overnight.
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Put the pork skin-side up on a rack over a tray with the bay leaves and 1 cup water, and roast for 30 minutes, until the skin starts to blister.
Reduce to 150°C (130°C fan) and roast for 4 hours, until the meat is very tender and reads 90°C in the centre.
Raise the oven to 230°C (210°C fan) for 15 minutes, until the crackling is crisp. Rest for 20 minutes, then pull the meat apart.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach at least 70°C inside; for pulled pork 90°C gives the best texture. Rest it before carving.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Venezuelan-Style Shredded Beef and Black Bean Bowls
recipes.summary: Slow-cooked shredded beef with black beans, rice and fried plantain.
steps: Brown the beef in 1 tablespoon of oil in a heavy pot for 8 minutes, until deep golden, then add the onion, capsicum, garlic and cumin for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and stock, cover and simmer very gently for 2 hours, until the beef shreds easily. Shred it in the sauce.
Warm the beans in a small pan for 5 minutes, until hot. Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Fry the plantain in the remaining oil for 3 minutes each side, until golden and soft. Serve the beef over rice with beans, plantain and cheese.
notes: Food safety: beef chuck is safe at 75°C and tender once it shreds; the sauce should be steaming hot.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Colombian-Style Scrambled Eggs on Corn Tortillas
recipes.summary: Tomato and spring onion scrambled eggs on warm, lightly toasted corn tortillas.
steps: Melt the butter in a frying pan over medium heat and cook the spring onion and tomato for 3 minutes, until soft and juicy.
Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt, pour in and stir gently for 3 minutes, until just set.
Toast the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds each side, until warm and flecked.
Pile the eggs on the tortillas and top with avocado and coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until set with no raw egg left if serving to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Argentine Skirt Steak with Chimichurri and Potatoes
recipes.summary: Charred skirt steak with a parsley, garlic and vinegar chimichurri and crisp roast potatoes.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the potato with 3 tablespoons of oil and salt and roast for 35 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp.
Mix the parsley, oregano, garlic, vinegar, 1/2 cup oil and chilli flakes for the chimichurri and leave it to sit for 15 minutes.
Season the steak and cook in a very hot pan for 3 minutes each side for medium-rare, until charred and a thermometer reads 55°C, then rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the steak across the grain and serve with the potatoes and plenty of chimichurri.
notes: Food safety: a whole steak is safe once seared on the outside; 55°C is medium-rare, 63°C medium, 71°C well done. Serve minced or pierced cuts well done.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Peruvian-Style Roast Chicken with Lime and Cumin
recipes.summary: Chicken pieces rubbed with cumin, paprika and lime, roasted until crisp-skinned.
steps: Mix the garlic, lime juice, cumin, paprika, oregano, soy sauce and oil. Rub it over the chicken and marinate for 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Spread the potato and onion on a large tray and set the chicken on top.
Roast for 45 minutes, turning the potato once, until the chicken is golden and the potato is crisp.
Check the thickest piece reaches 75°C, rest for 5 minutes and serve with the pan juices.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part, with clear juices.

recipes.title: Tapioca Cheese Rolls
recipes.summary: Chewy, airy tapioca bread rolls with melted cheese in the middle.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and line a tray with baking paper.
Bring the milk, oil, water and salt to the boil in a pot, then pour over the tapioca starch in a bowl and stir until a sticky dough forms. Cool for 10 minutes.
Beat in the egg until smooth, then fold through the cheese.
Roll tablespoons of dough into balls, set them 3cm apart on the tray and bake for 25 minutes, until puffed and pale golden.
notes: Food safety: the egg cooks through in the oven; the puffs are done when golden and no longer wet inside.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Plantain and Egg Breakfast Plate
recipes.summary: Sweet fried plantain, soft eggs, black beans and avocado.

items: 2 plantain, ripe and sliced on the diagonal

steps: Warm the black beans in a small pan for 4 minutes, until hot.
Fry the plantain in the oil in a frying pan for 3 minutes each side, until deep golden and soft. Lift out onto a plate.
Fry the eggs in the same pan for 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Serve the plantain, eggs, beans and avocado with coriander and lime.
notes: Food safety: cook until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Chermoula Chicken Braise with Green Olives
recipes.summary: Chicken braised in a fresh herb and spice chermoula with green olives and preserved lemon.
steps: Blend the coriander, parsley, garlic, cumin, paprika, oil and lemon juice into a loose paste. Coat the chicken and marinate for 1 hour.
Cook the onion in a wide pot for 5 minutes, until soft. Add the chicken and chermoula and brown for 6 minutes.
Add the stock, preserved lemon and olives, cover and simmer for 35 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C.
Soak the couscous in 1 1/2 cups of boiling water for 5 minutes, then fluff and serve under the chicken.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part, with juices running clear.

recipes.title: Moroccan Slow-Roast Lamb Shoulder
recipes.summary: Lamb shoulder rubbed with ras el hanout and honey, slow-roasted until it pulls apart.
steps: Mix the ras el hanout, garlic, oil, honey and lemon juice into a paste and rub it all over the lamb. Rest for at least 2 hours.
Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan). Sit the lamb on the onion in a deep roasting dish, pour in the stock and cover tightly with foil.
Roast for 4 hours, until very tender and 90°C in the centre. Add the apricots for the last 30 minutes.
Uncover, raise the heat to 220°C (200°C fan) and roast for 15 minutes, until the top is dark and sticky. Rest for 15 minutes and scatter with almonds.
notes: Food safety: lamb shoulder is safe at 63°C, and slow-roasted until 90°C it pulls apart. Rest before carving.

recipes.title: Tunisian Egg Brik with Tuna and Capers
recipes.summary: Crisp filo parcels with a runny egg, tuna, capers and parsley.
steps: Mix the tuna, capers, parsley, spring onion and cheese in a bowl.
Lay two filo sheets on the bench, brush the top with oil and spoon the tuna mix into the centre, pressing a small well in it. Crack an egg into the well.
Fold the filo over into a triangle and seal the edges quickly with a little oil.
Shallow-fry each brik in the remaining oil for 2 minutes per side, until deep golden and crisp. Serve hot with lemon.
notes: Food safety: the yolk is meant to stay soft; cook it until firm, or skip this dish, for young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Pescatarian.

recipes.title: Harissa Roast Chicken with Chickpeas
recipes.summary: A whole chicken rubbed with harissa and roasted over sweet onions and chickpeas.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Mix the harissa, oil and lemon juice and rub it over and under the skin of the chicken.
Toss the chickpeas, onion, garlic and cumin in a roasting dish and sit the chicken on top.
Roast for 1 hour 20 minutes, until the skin is dark and crisp and the thigh juices run clear, with the thickest part at 75°C.
Rest for 15 minutes, scatter with coriander and serve with yoghurt.
notes: Food safety: whole chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part of the thigh; rest it before carving.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Chermoula Baked Fish with Tomatoes and Potatoes
recipes.summary: White fish fillets baked on potato and tomato under a fresh chermoula.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Layer the potato in an oiled baking dish, season and roast for 15 minutes, until starting to soften.
Mix the coriander, parsley, garlic, cumin, paprika, oil and lemon juice into a chermoula.
Layer the tomato over the potato, set the fish on top and spoon over the chermoula.
Bake for 18 minutes, until the fish turns opaque and flakes easily and the potato is tender. Serve with lemon.
notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when opaque and it flakes with a fork.

recipes.title: Spiced Chickpea Breakfast Plate with Poached Eggs
recipes.summary: Warm cumin-spiced chickpeas topped with poached eggs, yoghurt and herbs.
steps: Warm the oil in a pan and cook the garlic, cumin and paprika for 1 minute, until fragrant. Add the chickpeas and tomato and simmer for 6 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas, until thick.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water for 3 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks soft.
Spoon the chickpeas into bowls, top with yoghurt and the eggs.
Finish with parsley and a swirl of harissa.
notes: Food safety: cook until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Lamb, Apricot and Almond Tagine
recipes.summary: Tender lamb braised with apricots, honey and warm spices, finished with toasted almonds.
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil in a heavy pot for 8 minutes, until golden, then lift out. Cook the onion in the same pot for 6 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin, ginger, cinnamon and saffron for 1 minute, then return the lamb with the tomatoes and stock.
Cover and simmer gently for 1 hour 15 minutes, until the lamb is tender. Add the apricots and honey and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes, until the sauce thickens.
Soak the couscous in 2 cups of boiling water for 5 minutes, fluff and serve with the tagine, scattered with almonds.
notes: Food safety: lamb is safe at 63°C; this braise is cooked long past that, and the stew should be steaming hot.

recipes.title: Seven-Vegetable Couscous
recipes.summary: A large dish of fluffy couscous with a fragrant vegetable and chickpea stew.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil in a wide pot for 6 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic, ras el hanout and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and stock, then the carrot, turnip and pumpkin. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes, until nearly tender.
Add the zucchini, chickpeas and raisins and simmer for 12 minutes, until all the vegetables are tender.
Soak the couscous in 2 cups of boiling water for 5 minutes, fluff with a fork and serve under the vegetables, scattered with parsley.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Prawns in Spicy Chermoula Tomato with Couscous
recipes.summary: Prawns cooked in a spiced tomato and herb sauce over fluffy couscous.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic, cumin, paprika and chilli for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes, until thick.
Stir in the prawns and cook for 4 minutes, until pink, curled and opaque.
Soak the couscous in 1 1/2 cups of boiling water for 5 minutes, fluff and serve under the prawns with coriander and lemon juice.
notes: Food safety: prawns are cooked when pink, curled and opaque all the way through.

recipes.title: Maqluba Upside-Down Chicken and Rice
recipes.summary: A fragrant pot of spiced chicken, fried eggplant and rice turned out like a cake.
steps: Boil the chicken with the onion and half the spices in water for 25 minutes, until cooked through, then drain, saving 3 cups of the stock. Rinse the rice and soak for 20 minutes.
Fry the eggplant in the oil for 3 minutes each side, until golden, and drain on paper.
Line the base of a large pot with the tomato, then the eggplant, then the chicken. Toss the rice with the remaining spices and layer over the top.
Pour over the stock, bring to the boil, cover and cook on low for 35 minutes, until the rice is tender and the stock absorbed. Rest for 10 minutes.
Turn the pot out onto a platter, scatter with pine nuts and serve with yoghurt.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C right through before layering; rest the rice covered and refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Lamb and Pistachio Kofta with Sumac Onions
recipes.summary: Herby spiced lamb skewers with pistachios, served with sumac onions and warm flatbread.
steps: Mix the lamb, pistachios, grated onion, garlic, cumin, coriander, allspice, parsley and a good pinch of salt. Shape into 12 long ovals and chill for 20 minutes.
Toss the red onion with the sumac and a pinch of salt and leave to soften.
Cook the kofta in the oil in a hot pan for 10 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through at 75°C.
Warm the flatbread and serve the kofta with the sumac onions and yoghurt.
notes: Food safety: lamb mince must reach 75°C all the way through; no pink should remain.

recipes.title: Fatteh with Chickpeas and Garlic Yoghurt
recipes.summary: Crisp pita layered with warm chickpeas and garlicky yoghurt, topped with toasted pine nuts.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the pita with the oil and bake for 8 minutes, until crisp and golden.
Warm the chickpeas with the cumin and a splash of water for 6 minutes, until hot and soft.
Stir the yoghurt, garlic and tahini together. Brown the pine nuts in the butter in a small pan for 3 minutes, until golden.
Layer the pita, chickpeas and yoghurt in a dish and pour over the pine nut butter. Finish with parsley.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Sabich Eggplant and Egg Pita
recipes.summary: Fried eggplant and boiled egg in a pita with tahini, tomato and pickles.
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, until hard, then cool, peel and slice.
Fry the eggplant in the oil in batches for 3 minutes each side, until golden and soft. Drain on paper.
Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice and 3 tablespoons of water until smooth.
Open the pita and fill with eggplant, egg, tomato, cucumber, pickles and parsley, then spoon in the tahini and amchur.
notes: Food safety: hard-boil the eggs until firm; refrigerate leftovers.
Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Chicken Musakhan with Sumac Onions
recipes.summary: Roast chicken piled on flatbread with sumac-sweet onions and toasted pine nuts.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Rub the chicken with half the oil, 1 tablespoon of sumac, allspice and cinnamon and roast for 40 minutes, until golden.
Cook the onion in the remaining oil for 15 minutes, until very soft and sweet. Stir in the remaining sumac.
Check the chicken reaches 75°C, then warm the flatbread in the oven for 3 minutes.
Top the flatbread with the onions and chicken, scatter with pine nuts and parsley and serve with yoghurt.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part, with clear juices.

recipes.title: Layered Lamb and Bulgur Kibbeh Tray
recipes.summary: Layers of spiced bulgur and lamb with a sweet lamb and pine nut filling, baked until golden.
steps: Soak the bulgur in cold water for 20 minutes, then drain and squeeze dry. Blend with the 500g mince, grated onion, allspice, cinnamon and salt into a smooth paste.
Cook the diced onion in 1 tablespoon of oil for 5 minutes, then add the 300g mince, pine nuts and cumin and cook for 8 minutes, until browned and cooked through. Cool.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Press half the kibbeh paste into an oiled baking dish, spread the filling over, then top with the remaining paste and smooth it.
Score into diamonds, drizzle with the remaining oil and bake for 40 minutes, until deep golden and cooked through. Serve with yoghurt.
notes: Food safety: lamb mince must reach 75°C right through; the middle of the kibbeh should be steaming hot.
Contains gluten (bulgur).

recipes.title: Eggs with Za'atar and Labneh on Flatbread
recipes.summary: Soft eggs with olive oil, za'atar and tangy labneh on warm flatbread.
steps: Warm the flatbread in a dry pan or oven for 2 minutes, until soft.
Fry the eggs in half the oil for 3 minutes, until the whites are set and edges crisp.
Spread the labneh over the flatbread and top with the eggs.
Drizzle with the remaining oil, scatter with za'atar and serve with cucumber, tomato, mint and olives.
notes: Food safety: cook until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Spiced Beef and Rice Stuffed Zucchini
recipes.summary: Hollowed zucchini filled with spiced beef and rice and simmered in tomato sauce.
steps: Cut the top off each zucchini and scoop out the flesh with an apple corer, keeping the walls about 5mm thick.
Mix the mince, rice, allspice, cinnamon, parsley, oil and a good pinch of salt. Fill each zucchini only two-thirds full as the rice swells.
Pack the zucchini into a wide pot. Mix the tomatoes, stock, paste and lemon juice and pour over.
Cover and simmer for 45 minutes, until the zucchini and rice are tender. Serve with yoghurt.
notes: Food safety: the mince filling must reach 75°C right through; the rice should be soft and the sauce steaming hot.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Saffron Chicken with Pomegranate and Walnuts
recipes.summary: Chicken in a tangy, nutty pomegranate molasses sauce lifted with saffron.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a heavy pot for 8 minutes, until golden, then lift out. Cook the onion for 6 minutes, until soft.
Stir in the walnuts and toast for 3 minutes, until fragrant. Add the molasses, saffron, cinnamon, stock and honey and bring to a simmer.
Return the chicken, cover and simmer very gently for 40 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C and the sauce is thick and dark.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, drain and serve with the chicken, scattered with pomegranate.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part, with clear juices.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Roast Eggplant with Spiced Lamb and Pine Nuts
recipes.summary: Soft roasted eggplant halves topped with spiced lamb, tahini yoghurt and pine nuts.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Score the eggplant flesh, brush with half the oil and roast cut-side up for 35 minutes, until soft and golden.
Cook the onion in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, then add the lamb, garlic and spices and cook for 8 minutes, until browned and cooked through. Stir in the paste.
Mix the yoghurt and tahini with a splash of water.
Pile the lamb onto the eggplant, then top with the yoghurt, pine nuts and parsley.
notes: Food safety: lamb mince must reach 75°C right through before serving.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Jamaican-Style Curry Lamb
recipes.summary: Lamb shoulder braised with curry powder, allspice, thyme and scotch bonnet until meltingly tender.
steps: Toss the lamb with half the curry powder, the allspice, garlic and ginger and marinate for 2 hours.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot, add the remaining curry powder and the onion and cook for 6 minutes, until soft. Add the lamb and brown for 8 minutes.
Add the water, scotch bonnet and thyme, cover and simmer for 1 hour 15 minutes, until the lamb is tender. Add the potato and carrot and cook for 20 minutes, until soft. Remove the scotch bonnet.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, then drain and serve with the curry.
notes: Food safety: lamb is safe at 63°C; this braise is cooked far beyond that. Handle scotch bonnet with gloves and keep it whole for gentle heat.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Callaloo-Style Egg Scramble with Fried Plantain
recipes.summary: Greens, tomato and thyme scrambled with eggs and served with golden fried plantain.
steps: Fry the plantain in the coconut oil for 3 minutes each side, until golden and caramelised. Lift out.
Cook the spring onion, garlic, thyme and tomato in the oil for 3 minutes, until soft.
Add the spinach and cook for 2 minutes, until wilted, then pour in the whisked eggs.
Stir gently for 3 minutes, until just set. Serve with the plantain.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until set with no raw egg left if serving to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Garlicky Black Bean and Plantain Rice Bowls
recipes.summary: Garlicky black beans over rice with fried plantain, avocado and lime.
steps: Cook the onion and capsicum in the olive oil for 6 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic, cumin and oregano for 1 minute.
Add the beans, bay leaf and 1/2 cup water and simmer for 15 minutes, until thick. Stir in the vinegar.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and drain. Fry the plantain in the neutral oil for 3 minutes each side, until golden.
Serve the beans over rice with plantain, avocado and lime.
notes: Vegan. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Puerto Rican-Style Chicken with Sofrito and Olives
recipes.summary: Chicken thighs simmered in a garlicky pepper sofrito with green olives and potato.
steps: Blend the capsicum, onion, garlic, coriander, cumin and oregano into a rough sofrito.
Brown the chicken in the oil in a wide pot for 8 minutes, until golden. Add the sofrito and tomato paste and cook for 5 minutes, until thick.
Add the stock, olives and potato, cover and simmer for 30 minutes, until the potato is tender and the chicken reaches 75°C.
Uncover and simmer for 5 minutes, until the sauce thickens.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part, with clear juices.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Coconut Prawn Skewers with Pineapple
recipes.summary: Prawns and pineapple threaded onto skewers, glazed with a coconut, lime and chilli marinade.
steps: Mix the coconut cream, lime juice, garlic, ginger and chilli, then toss the prawns through.
Thread the prawns and pineapple onto skewers.
Cook on a hot, oiled grill pan for 4 minutes, turning once, until the prawns are pink and opaque and the pineapple is charred.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and serve with the skewers and coriander.
notes: Food safety: prawns are cooked when pink, curled and opaque all the way through; don't re-use the raw prawn marinade as a sauce unless boiled.

recipes.title: Jamaican Cornmeal Porridge
recipes.summary: Creamy cornmeal porridge cooked in coconut milk with nutmeg, cinnamon and vanilla.
steps: Whisk the polenta with 1 cup of the water to make a smooth slurry.
Bring the remaining water, coconut milk, cinnamon stick, nutmeg and salt to a gentle simmer, until steaming.
Stir in the polenta slurry and cook for 15 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Remove the cinnamon, stir through the sugar and vanilla and serve hot.
notes: Vegan. Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Haitian-Style Griot Pork with Citrus
recipes.summary: Pork shoulder simmered in citrus and spices, then browned until crisp at the edges.
steps: Combine the pork, orange juice, lime juice, garlic, onion, scotch bonnet, thyme and salt and marinate for 2 hours.
Simmer the pork and marinade in a pot with 1 cup water for 45 minutes, until tender. Drain and keep the liquid.
Heat the oil in a wide pan and fry the pork for 12 minutes, turning, until browned and crisp at the edges and 70°C in the middle.
Fry the plantain in the pan for 3 minutes each side, until golden. Serve with the pork and pickled cabbage.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach 70°C inside; keep the scotch bonnet whole and remove before serving.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Caribbean Pumpkin and Coconut Curry
recipes.summary: A mild, sweet pumpkin and chickpea curry in coconut milk with thyme and allspice.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder and allspice for 1 minute.
Add the pumpkin, thyme, chickpeas and coconut milk with 1/2 cup water. Simmer for 20 minutes, until the pumpkin is tender.
Stir through the spinach for 2 minutes, until wilted.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and serve with the curry.
notes: Vegan. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Hungarian Lecso with Smoked Sausage
recipes.summary: Capsicum and tomato stewed with onion and paprika, with smoked sausage and a poached egg.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, until soft, then stir in the paprika for 30 seconds.
Add the capsicum and cook for 8 minutes, then add the tomato and simmer for 10 minutes, until thick and sweet.
Add the sausage and cook for 5 minutes, until hot all the way through.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 4 minutes, until the whites are set. Serve with bread and parsley.
notes: Food safety: cook the whites until set; the sausage must be steaming hot (75°C) inside.

recipes.title: Polish Cabbage Rolls in Tomato Sauce
recipes.summary: Cabbage leaves wrapped around pork, beef and rice and baked in a tomato sauce.
steps: Boil the whole cabbage for 10 minutes, until the leaves peel away easily. Cut out the core and separate 12 leaves, shaving the thick ribs.
Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes. Mix with the mince, rice, egg, paprika and 1 teaspoon of salt.
Place a spoonful of filling on each leaf, fold in the sides and roll tightly.

Pack the rolls seam-side down in a baking dish, pour over the tomatoes, stock and tomato paste, cover and bake at 180°C (160°C fan) for 1 hour 30 minutes, until the rice is tender and the filling reaches 75°C.
Rest for 10 minutes and scatter with parsley.
notes: Food safety: mince filling must reach 75°C right through.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Bauernfruhstuck Farmer's Breakfast
recipes.summary: Crisp potato, bacon and onion with eggs set over the top and chives.
steps: Boil the potato for 8 minutes, until just tender, then drain and dry.
Fry the bacon in a large frying pan for 5 minutes, until crisp. Add the butter, onion and potato and cook for 10 minutes, turning now and then, until golden.
Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and pour them over the potatoes.
Cook gently for 4 minutes, until the egg is just set, then scatter with chives and serve with pickles.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until firm, with no raw egg left, for young children, older people or anyone pregnant; the bacon should be cooked through.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Swiss Rosti with Fried Eggs and Smoked Salmon
recipes.summary: Crisp grated-potato cake topped with fried egg and silky smoked salmon.
steps: Squeeze the grated potato and onion in a clean tea towel to remove the liquid, then season with salt.
Heat the butter and oil in a non-stick pan and press the potato into a flat round about 2cm thick.
Cook over medium heat for 10 minutes per side, until deep golden and crisp, flipping with a plate.
Fry the eggs for 3 minutes, until the whites are set. Top the rosti with the eggs, salmon, creme fraiche and chives.
notes: Food safety: cook until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to children, older people or anyone pregnant. Smoked salmon is not recommended during pregnancy.
Gluten-free. Pescatarian.

recipes.title: Czech-Style Roast Pork with Caraway and Sauerkraut
recipes.summary: Caraway-crusted pork shoulder roasted until tender, served with sauerkraut and potatoes.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Rub the pork with the caraway, garlic, oil and salt and sit it on the onion in a roasting dish.
Pour the beer around the pork, cover and roast for 30 minutes.
Reduce to 160°C (140°C fan), add the potato to the dish and roast for 1 hour 30 minutes, uncovering for the last 30, until the pork reaches 85°C and is tender.
Warm the sauerkraut for 5 minutes, until hot. Rest the pork for 15 minutes, slice and serve with the potatoes, pan juices and sauerkraut.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach at least 70°C inside; at 85°C the shoulder slices cleanly.
Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Kasespatzle with Caramelised Onion
recipes.summary: Swabian egg noodles layered with melted cheese and sweet, sticky onions.
steps: Cook the onion with 2 tablespoons of the butter and the oil over low heat for 25 minutes, stirring often, until deep golden and sweet.
Beat the flour, eggs, milk, nutmeg and salt into a thick, elastic batter and rest it for 10 minutes.
Press the batter through a spatzle maker or colander into a pot of salted boiling water in batches. Cook for 2 minutes, until they float, and lift out.
Layer the spatzle with the cheeses in a warm dish, tossing with the remaining butter until melted and stringy. Top with the onions and chives.
notes: Food safety: the noodle batter contains raw egg: cook it until the noodles float and are firm.
Vegetarian.
